welcome.subject: Welcome to Oda Platform {userName} 🚀
welcome.title: Welcome to Oda
welcome.body: We're delighted to have you join our journey of literary and artistic translation with artificial intelligence. Here, words are translated by their spirit, not just their letters. We've prepared a short tour to help you start your first translation project.

emailVerification.subject: Verify your email to continue
emailVerification.title: One Last Step to Activate Your Account
emailVerification.body: To complete creating your Oda account, please verify your email within 24 hours. This step protects your account and ensures your notifications reach you.

emailVerified.subject: Your email has been successfully verified ✅
emailVerified.title: Your Account Is Ready to Go
emailVerified.body: Your email has been successfully verified. All of Oda's features are now at your fingertips, from literary translation to creative editing tools.

passwordReset.subject: Password Reset Request
passwordReset.title: Reset Your Password
passwordReset.body: We received a request to reset your account password. The link below is valid for one hour only. If you didn't request this, ignore this message and inform the security team.

passwordResetSuccess.subject: Password changed successfully
passwordResetSuccess.title: Password Updated
passwordResetSuccess.body: Your account password was successfully changed at {time}. If it wasn't you, please contact {securityEmail} immediately to secure your account.

passwordChanged.subject: Alert: Your password has been updated
passwordChanged.title: Password Updated
passwordChanged.body: We're informing you that your account password was just changed from your device. If you didn't perform this action, contact us immediately.

loginAlert.subject: New sign-in to your account
loginAlert.title: Sign-in Alert
loginAlert.body: Your account was signed into at {time} from {location} via {device}. If that was you, ignore this message. If not, secure your account now.

loginNewDevice.subject: Sign-in from a new device 🔐
loginNewDevice.title: New Device Detected
loginNewDevice.body: Someone signed into your account from a device we didn't recognize: {device} - {location}. If this was you, no need to worry. Otherwise, change your password immediately.

loginSuspicious.subject: ⚠️ Suspicious sign-in attempt
loginSuspicious.title: Unusual Activity on Your Account
loginSuspicious.body: We detected a suspicious sign-in attempt to your account from {location} at {time}. The attempt was automatically blocked. We strongly advise changing your password and enabling two-factor authentication.

accountLocked.subject: Your account has been temporarily locked 🔒
accountLocked.title: Your Account Is Locked for Your Protection
accountLocked.body: The number of failed sign-in attempts was exceeded, so we've temporarily locked your account for {duration}. You can restore access now by resetting your password.

accountUnlocked.subject: Your account has been unlocked
accountUnlocked.title: Your Account Is Ready to Use
accountUnlocked.body: Your account has been reopened. You can now sign in normally. We recommend reviewing your security settings to avoid recurrence.

emailChange.subject: Confirm email address change
emailChange.title: Confirm New Email
emailChange.body: We received a request to change your email address to {newEmail}. Confirm the change within an hour to complete the process.

emailChanged.subject: Your email address has been updated
emailChanged.title: Email Address Updated
emailChanged.body: Your account email was successfully updated to {newEmail}. All future notifications will be sent to this email.

usernameChanged.subject: Username has been changed
usernameChanged.title: Username Updated
usernameChanged.body: Your username has been updated to @{newUsername}. This name will appear on all your translations and posts.

accountDeactivated.subject: Your account has been temporarily deactivated
accountDeactivated.title: We Hope to See You Back Soon
accountDeactivated.body: Your account has been deactivated at your request. Your data is preserved for {duration}, during which you can reactivate the account by signing in again. After that, the account will be permanently deleted.

subscriptionStarted.subject: Your {planName} subscription has been activated 🎉
subscriptionStarted.title: Welcome to {planName}
subscriptionStarted.body: Your {planName} plan subscription has been activated. You can now access unlimited translations and advanced AI tools until {expiryDate}.

subscriptionUpgraded.subject: Your subscription has been upgraded to {planName} ⬆️
subscriptionUpgraded.title: Upgrade Successful
subscriptionUpgraded.body: Your subscription has been upgraded to the {planName} plan. All new features are activated from this moment and will appear in your next invoice.

subscriptionDowngraded.subject: Your subscription has been downgraded to {planName}
subscriptionDowngraded.title: Plan Change
subscriptionDowngraded.body: Your subscription has been downgraded to the {planName} plan, effective from {effectiveDate}. Until then, you enjoy the full features of your current plan.

subscriptionCancelled.subject: Your subscription has been cancelled
subscriptionCancelled.title: We're Sorry to See You Go
subscriptionCancelled.body: Your {planName} subscription has been cancelled. Your features will continue until the end of the paid period on {expiryDate}. We wish you well, and our door is open whenever you return.

subscriptionRenewed.subject: Your subscription has been automatically renewed
subscriptionRenewed.title: Your Subscription Is Renewed
subscriptionRenewed.body: Your {planName} subscription was successfully renewed for {amount}. The subscription is valid until {newExpiryDate}.

subscriptionExpiringSoon.subject: Your subscription expires in {daysLeft} days
subscriptionExpiringSoon.title: Subscription Expiry Reminder
subscriptionExpiringSoon.body: Your {planName} subscription expires in {daysLeft} days. Renew now to keep your projects and translations without interruption.

subscriptionExpired.subject: Your Oda subscription has expired
subscriptionExpired.title: Time to Renew
subscriptionExpired.body: Your subscription has expired. Your account has been moved to the free plan, and your projects are saved. Renew to restore advanced features.

paymentSuccess.subject: Payment Confirmation - {amount}
paymentSuccess.title: Your Payment Was Received
paymentSuccess.body: {amount} was successfully charged via {paymentMethod} on {date}. Transaction ID: {transactionId}. You'll find the invoice in the download link below.

paymentFailed.subject: ⚠️ Payment Failed
paymentFailed.title: Unable to Complete Payment
paymentFailed.body: We were unable to charge {amount} via {paymentMethod}. Reason: {reason}. Update your payment method to avoid service interruption.

paymentRetry.subject: We'll retry your payment by {retryDate}
paymentRetry.title: New Attempt Coming Soon
paymentRetry.body: We'll retry charging {amount} on {retryDate}. Make sure your balance is available or update your payment method to avoid a failed attempt.

invoiceReady.subject: Your new invoice from Oda - {invoiceNumber}
invoiceReady.title: New Invoice
invoiceReady.body: Your invoice {invoiceNumber} for {amount} is ready for download. The invoice is compliant with the requirements of the Zakat, Tax and Customs Authority in Saudi Arabia.

refundProcessed.subject: Your refund request has been processed
refundProcessed.title: {amount} Refunded
refundProcessed.body: Your refund request for {amount} has been approved. The amount will appear in your account within 5-10 business days depending on your bank.

translationStarted.subject: Translation of "{projectTitle}" has started 📖
translationStarted.title: Translation in Progress
translationStarted.body: We've started translating your work "{projectTitle}" from {sourceLang} to {targetLang}. Estimated time: {estimatedTime}. We'll notify you as soon as it's done.

translationCompleted.subject: Translation of "{projectTitle}" is complete ✨
translationCompleted.title: Your Translation Is Ready
translationCompleted.body: The translation of "{projectTitle}" has been completed successfully. We preserved the spirit of the original text and the author's voice as much as possible. Please review it and let us know your thoughts.

translationFailed.subject: Unable to complete translation of "{projectTitle}"
translationFailed.title: An Error Occurred During Processing
translationFailed.body: We encountered a problem while processing "{projectTitle}". Reason: {reason}. Your credits were not deducted. Please try again, and if the problem persists, contact {supportEmail}.

translationReviewReady.subject: Translation of "{projectTitle}" is awaiting your review
translationReviewReady.title: Time to Review
translationReviewReady.body: We've completed translating your work. Human review is the most important step to ensure literary fidelity. You have {reviewDays} days to review it.

translationApproved.subject: Your translation has been approved ✅
translationApproved.title: Translation Approved
translationApproved.body: Your translation of "{projectTitle}" has been approved. It is now ready for publishing or export in any format you choose.

translationRejected.subject: Translation of "{projectTitle}" needs review
translationRejected.title: Translation Feedback
translationRejected.body: After review, we find that the translation needs revisions. Notes: {feedback}. You can edit the original text or request reprocessing with a different style.

translationExported.subject: Your translation has been exported in {format} format
translationExported.title: Your File Is Ready
translationExported.body: "{projectTitle}" has been exported in {format} format. The link is valid for 7 days. You can also access the file from your profile at any time.

translationShared.subject: Your translation "{projectTitle}" has been shared
translationShared.title: Your Translation Is Spreading
translationShared.body: {sharerName} shared your translation "{projectTitle}" with {viewers} readers. Follow your work reaching a wider audience.

storyUploaded.subject: "{storyTitle}" has been uploaded successfully
storyUploaded.title: Your Story Is Safe
storyUploaded.body: Your story "{storyTitle}" ({wordCount} words) has been uploaded successfully. It is now in your private space, ready for translation or editing.

storyPublished.subject: "{storyTitle}" has been published 📢
storyPublished.title: Your Work Is Now for the World
storyPublished.body: Your story "{storyTitle}" has been published on the platform. It is now available to followers and readers, and is a candidate for the "Featured Works" section.

storyArchived.subject: "{storyTitle}" has been archived
storyArchived.title: Work in Archive
storyArchived.body: "{storyTitle}" has been moved to the archive. It won't be visible to readers, but it's preserved with all its edits and translations. You can restore it at any time.

storyDeleted.subject: "{storyTitle}" has been deleted
storyDeleted.title: Work Deletion Confirmed
storyDeleted.body: "{storyTitle}" has been permanently deleted at your request. We no longer retain any copy. We hope you continue enriching the platform with new works.

draftSaved.subject: Draft automatically saved
draftSaved.title: Your Work Is Safe
draftSaved.body: We automatically saved your draft "{draftTitle}". Last edited: {savedAt}. Continue from where you left off at any time.

translationLimitReached.subject: You've reached your monthly translation limit
translationLimitReached.title: Monthly Credits Exhausted
translationLimitReached.body: You've used {usedCount} out of {totalCount} translations in your current plan. To continue without interruption, upgrade your plan or wait for renewal on {renewalDate}.

translationQuotaWarning.subject: You're approaching your translation limit (%{usedPercent})
translationQuotaWarning.title: Usage Alert
translationQuotaWarning.body: You've used {usedPercent}% of your plan's translations. You have {remaining} translations left until renewal on {renewalDate}.

newFollower.subject: {followerName} is now following you
newFollower.title: New Follower
newFollower.body: {followerName} started following you. Your follower count is now: {followersCount}. Visit their profile and discover their works.

milestoneFollowers.subject: You've reached {milestone} followers 🎉
milestoneFollowers.title: New Achievement
milestoneFollowers.body: Your follower count has reached {milestone}. Thank you for enriching the platform with your works. Share your achievement with your audience.

authorFollowedYouBack.subject: {authorName} is now following you back
authorFollowedYouBack.title: Mutual Following
authorFollowedYouBack.body: {authorName} has followed you back. This is an opportunity to start a fruitful literary dialogue. Check out their latest works.

commentReply.subject: {replierName} replied to your comment
commentReply.title: New Reply
commentReply.body: {replierName} replied to your comment in "{contentTitle}". Continue the conversation with readers.

milestoneLikes.subject: "{contentTitle}" surpassed {milestone} likes
milestoneLikes.title: Your Work Is at the Top
milestoneLikes.body: The likes on "{contentTitle}" have reached {milestone}. Your audience appreciates what you write.

authorYouFollowPublished.subject: {authorName} published a new work
authorYouFollowPublished.title: New Release from an Author You Follow
authorYouFollowPublished.body: {authorName} published their new work "{workTitle}". Perhaps worth reading tonight.

trendingPost.subject: Your work "{contentTitle}" is trending 🔥
trendingPost.title: On the Most Engaged List
trendingPost.body: Your work "{contentTitle}" entered the most engaged works list this week, with an engagement rate higher than 87% of platform works.

featuredAuthor.subject: You've been selected as a featured author 🌟
featuredAuthor.title: Author of the Week
featuredAuthor.body: The Oda team has selected you as this week's featured author. Your profile will be featured on the homepage and in the readers' mailing list.

weeklyDigest.subject: Your weekly summary on Oda 📰
weeklyDigest.title: What Happened This Week
weeklyDigest.body: This week: {newWorks} new works in your library, {newFollowers} followers, {totalReads} reads. Discover the highlights in your detailed report.

monthlyDigest.subject: Summary of {monthName} - Your Achievements
monthlyDigest.title: Comprehensive Monthly Report
monthlyDigest.body: This month you accomplished: {translationsCount} translations, {storiesCount} stories, and gained {newFollowers} new followers. Your monthly report awaits you.

inactivityReminder.subject: We miss you on Oda, {userName}
inactivityReminder.title: Return to Your Literary Journey
inactivityReminder.body: {daysAway} days have passed since your last visit. Your drafts are waiting, and your followers are looking forward to a new work. Come back whenever you like.

comeBackOffer.subject: A special {discount}% discount for your return 🎁
comeBackOffer.title: We Missed You Offer
comeBackOffer.body: In celebration of your anticipated return, we've prepared a {discount}% discount on the {planName} plan for {duration}. Valid until {expiryDate}.

newFeature.subject: New feature on Oda: {featureName} ✨
newFeature.title: {featureName}
newFeature.body: We've launched {featureName}. {featureDescription}. Try it now in {section}.

featureRecommended.subject: A feature you might like
featureRecommended.title: A Discovery for You
featureRecommended.body: Based on your recent activity, we think the {featureName} feature will help you in your next project. {reason}

eventReminder.subject: Reminder: {eventName} starts {timeUntil}
eventReminder.title: Event Coming Up
eventReminder.body: The "{eventName}" event you registered for starts {timeUntil} ({eventDate}). The link is ready in your account.

webinarInvite.subject: Invitation: "{webinarTitle}" Webinar
webinarInvite.title: A Special Invitation for You
webinarInvite.body: We invite you to a webinar titled "{webinarTitle}" with {speakerName} on {webinarDate}. Seats are limited.

newsletterMonthly.subject: Oda Newsletter - {monthName} {year}
newsletterMonthly.title: News and Stories This Month
newsletterMonthly.body: In this issue: an interview with the author of the month, top translations, and the latest platform updates. Enjoy reading.

twoFactorEnabled.subject: Two-factor authentication has been enabled 🔐
twoFactorEnabled.title: Your Account Is More Secure
twoFactorEnabled.body: Two-factor authentication has been enabled on your account. We'll require an additional code with every new sign-in. Keep your backup codes in a safe place.

twoFactorDisabled.subject: ⚠️ Two-factor authentication has been disabled
twoFactorDisabled.title: Less Protection for Your Account
twoFactorDisabled.body: Two-factor authentication has been disabled. Your account is now less secure. We strongly recommend re-enabling it immediately, especially if you didn't perform this action.

apiKeyCreated.subject: A new API key has been created
apiKeyCreated.title: API Key
apiKeyCreated.body: An API key named "{keyName}" was created at {createdAt}. Keep it in a safe place. We will not be able to show it again.

apiKeyRevoked.subject: API key "{keyName}" has been revoked
apiKeyRevoked.title: Key Revoked
apiKeyRevoked.body: API key "{keyName}" was revoked at {revokedAt}. All applications depending on it will stop working.

dataExportReady.subject: Your data export is ready for download
dataExportReady.title: Your Data Is in Your Hands
dataExportReady.body: We've prepared a complete copy of your Oda data (translations, stories, settings). The link is valid for 48 hours. This is the "data sovereignty" practice we believe in.

dataDeletionConfirm.subject: Confirm permanent deletion of your data
dataDeletionConfirm.title: An Irreversible Action
dataDeletionConfirm.body: We received your request to delete all your data from Oda. This action cannot be undone. Confirm within 72 hours or the request will be cancelled.

privacyPolicyUpdate.subject: Privacy Policy Update - {effectiveDate}
privacyPolicyUpdate.title: New Version of the Privacy Policy
privacyPolicyUpdate.body: We updated our privacy policy to more clearly reflect the principles of "software sovereignty". Changes are effective on {effectiveDate}. We recommend reviewing them.

termsUpdate.subject: Terms of Service Update
termsUpdate.title: Updated Terms
termsUpdate.body: We've updated the Oda platform terms of service, effective from {effectiveDate}. By continuing to use the platform, you agree to the new terms.

securityBreach.subject: 🚨 Important Security Alert
securityBreach.title: Urgent Action Required
securityBreach.body: We detected a security incident that may affect your data. We've taken immediate measures to contain it. We strongly advise you to change your password and enable two-factor authentication.

sessionExpired.subject: Your Oda session has expired
sessionExpired.title: You've Been Automatically Signed Out
sessionExpired.body: Your session ended after {idleTime} of inactivity, to protect your account security. Sign in again to continue.

aiCreditsLow.subject: Your AI credits are running low
aiCreditsLow.title: Credits Alert
aiCreditsLow.body: You have {remainingCredits} points remaining from your AI credits. Topping up ensures your projects continue without interruption.

aiCreditsRefilled.subject: {amount} points successfully added
aiCreditsRefilled.title: Your Credits Are Ready
aiCreditsRefilled.body: {amount} AI points have been added to your account. Current balance: {totalCredits} points. Valid until {expiryDate}.

aiModelUpgrade.subject: Improved translation model now available
aiModelUpgrade.title: Translation Engine Upgrade
aiModelUpgrade.body: We've released the new {modelName} model. It delivers deeper translations for literary texts with better preservation of rhetorical figures and rhythm. Automatically enabled in your account.

aiTrainingComplete.subject: Your custom model training is complete
aiTrainingComplete.title: Your Model Is Ready
aiTrainingComplete.body: Your custom model "{modelName}" has been trained on {samplesCount} texts. It is now available for use in all your upcoming projects.

customStyleReady.subject: Your custom style "{styleName}" is ready
customStyleReady.title: Your Literary Signature
customStyleReady.body: We've prepared the custom translation style "{styleName}" based on your works. It will be applied to your upcoming translations to reflect your literary voice.

translationStyleSaved.subject: Style "{styleName}" has been saved
translationStyleSaved.title: New Style in Your Library
translationStyleSaved.body: Translation style "{styleName}" has been saved. You can invoke it in any upcoming project with a single click.

aiSuggestionsReady.subject: Improvement suggestions for "{projectTitle}"
aiSuggestionsReady.title: Smart Suggestions
aiSuggestionsReady.body: The AI analyzed your work "{projectTitle}" and prepared {suggestionsCount} suggestions to improve the narrative and rhythm. Adopt what suits you.

dictionaryUpdated.subject: Your personal dictionary has been updated
dictionaryUpdated.title: Your Dictionary Is Now Wider
dictionaryUpdated.body: {newTermsCount} new terms have been added to your custom dictionary based on your translations. This improves the accuracy and consistency of your upcoming translations.

invitationSent.subject: Your invitation to {inviteeName} has been sent
invitationSent.title: Invitation on the Way
invitationSent.body: Your invitation was sent to {inviteeEmail} to join project "{projectName}". We'll notify you when it's accepted.

invitationAccepted.subject: {inviteeName} accepted your invitation ✅
invitationAccepted.title: New Collaboration
invitationAccepted.body: {inviteeName} has joined your project "{projectName}". They can now work with you on the text.

teamMemberAdded.subject: You've been added to the "{teamName}" team
teamMemberAdded.title: Welcome to the Team
teamMemberAdded.body: {addedBy} added you to the "{teamName}" team with {role} permission. You can now contribute to team projects.

teamMemberRemoved.subject: You've been removed from the "{teamName}" team
teamMemberRemoved.title: Change in Your Membership
teamMemberRemoved.body: Your membership in the "{teamName}" team has been removed. You can no longer see team projects, but your previous contributions are preserved.

projectShared.subject: {sharerName} shared "{projectName}" with you
projectShared.title: New Project to Work On
projectShared.body: {sharerName} shared project "{projectName}" with you with {permission} permission. Review it and share your feedback.

collaboratorEdited.subject: {editorName} made edits in "{projectName}"
collaboratorEdited.title: New Edits
collaboratorEdited.body: {editorName} made edits to project "{projectName}". {editsCount} changes in {sectionsCount} sections.

workspaceCreated.subject: Workspace "{workspaceName}" has been created
workspaceCreated.title: Your New Space
workspaceCreated.body: Workspace "{workspaceName}" has been created. You can invite collaborators, organize projects, and share resources freely.

permissionGranted.subject: New permission on "{resourceName}"
permissionGranted.title: Your Permissions Have Expanded
permissionGranted.body: {grantedBy} granted you {permission} permission on "{resourceName}". You are now able to {capability}.

badgeEarned.subject: You earned the "{badgeName}" badge 🏅
badgeEarned.title: New Badge
badgeEarned.body: You earned the "{badgeName}" badge in recognition of {achievement}. The badge will appear on your public profile.

levelUp.subject: Promoted to Level {newLevel} ⬆️
levelUp.title: Higher Level
levelUp.body: You've risen to level {newLevel}. With each level, you unlock new features and higher limits. Continue your creative journey.

firstTranslation.subject: Your first translation on Oda 🎊
firstTranslation.title: The Most Important Beginning
firstTranslation.body: You've completed your first translation on the platform. This is the starting point of a long journey. We've gifted you {bonusCredits} AI points as a welcome gift.

anniversaryYear.subject: A year together on Oda 🎂
anniversaryYear.title: Happy Anniversary
anniversaryYear.body: You've completed a full year with us. During this year: {translationsCount} translations, {storiesCount} stories, and {followersGained} new followers. Thank you for a wonderful journey.

specialReward.subject: A special reward for you from Oda 🎁
specialReward.title: Thank You Gift
specialReward.body: In appreciation of your contributions to enriching the platform, we gift you {rewardDescription}. Valid until {expiryDate}.

ministerOfCulturePartnership.subject: Oda's Partnership with the Ministry of Culture 🇸🇦
ministerOfCulturePartnership.title: A Major National Step
ministerOfCulturePartnership.body: We are proud to announce our partnership with the Ministry of Culture of Saudi Arabia to support literary translation with artificial intelligence. As an author with us, you benefit from special upcoming programs.

codelabPartnership.subject: Oda and Codelab: A Technical Alliance
codelabPartnership.title: New Technical Partnership
codelabPartnership.body: We announced today our partnership with Codelab to support the technical infrastructure of the Oda platform, ensuring continued commitment to the principles of software sovereignty and deployment on Ubuntu.

competitionLaunch.subject: Launching "{competitionName}" Competition 📚
competitionLaunch.title: A New Literary Challenge
competitionLaunch.body: We're launching the "{competitionName}" competition with total prizes of {totalPrizes}. Registration deadline: {deadline}. Participate with your best translations.

competitionWinner.subject: 🏆 You won the "{competitionName}" competition
competitionWinner.title: Congratulations, Winner
competitionWinner.body: The judging panel announced your victory in {position} in the "{competitionName}" competition with prize {prize}. We will contact you for prize delivery.
